title.narrative: IMMUNIZATION

description.narrative: The Expanded Programme of Immunization is strengthened to contribute to the achievement of 85 per cent coverage of DPT3 vaccination among children under age 1 nationally, and to reduce inequities among regions, whilst introducing new vaccines that respond to public health needs, with sustained investments in cold chain management and the procurement of EPI and COVID-19 vaccines to serve as an entry point to revitalize primary health care.

title.narrative: UNICEF technical and financial assistance to restore routine immunization services combined with outreach and vaccination campaigns increased DPT3 coverage from 67 per cent in 2021 to 80 per cent in 2024. An integrated vaccination campaign has protected 805,768, around 91 per cent of the 881,815 targeted children aged between 9 months and 14 years against measles and rubella, and also provided Vitamin A to to 254,485; of the 325,845 targeted children aged 6-59 months (78 per cent), and deworming pill to 227,237 of the target 286,055 children aged 12-59 moths (79.4%).
